settings.title: 01  Set up
settings.text: Place the feeder somewhere calm and level, and connect it using the UK power supply.

settings.title: 02  Connect
settings.text: Pair the feeder with its companion app on your phone.

settings.title: 03  Schedule
settings.text: Set your pet's meal times and adjust them from the app whenever your routine changes. With the Video model, you can also check in with live video.

settings.heading: What is the difference between the WiFi and Video models?
settings.row_content: Both models offer app control, scheduled feeding and a UK power supply. The Video model adds a built-in camera, so you can see live video in the app.

settings.heading: Does it come with a UK plug?
settings.row_content: Yes. Both models are supplied with a UK power supply.
